prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Scandium (스칸듐) itself — the sovereign of the Scandium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: scandium: a light, soft silvery-white metal with a faint yellowish tarnish, predicted in 1871 as eka-boron in an empty space below boron and found in 1879 in Uppsala in Scandinavian euxenite and gadolinite ore, then quietly shown to fit the prediction exactly, and named for Scandinavia; a pinch of it alloyed into aluminium makes racing-bicycle frames and fighter-jet parts far stronger without adding weight; scandium iodide in metal-halide lamps gives the crisp, sun-like white light of night stadiums and film sets; it is scattered thinly through the earth and rarely gathered in one ore. Palette: floodlight white, light silvery aluminium, faint brass-yellow tarnish, cool Nordic night blue.

World (fixed): year 2200, a sky racing circuit: feather-light, rigid silver-alloy racing craft threading glowing ring gates high above the clouds, giant floodlight towers pouring sun-white light through the night, a floating pit deck where the racers are tuned. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) a sleek armored bodysuit — thin, long plates on the shoulders, arms and legs that follow her curves closely; 2) large wing-shaped binder plates spread symmetrically behind her back as the main shape, with light body armor; 3) light body armor with several small shield and drone units floating symmetrically around her; 4) a symmetrical pair of mechanical sub-arms reaching out from her back, ending in shields or tools — her own two human arms stay as they are; 5) a large equipment unit worn on the back (tanks, a cannon barrel or antennae) rising above her head as the main shape, with medium body armor; 6) a large ring halo behind her head and a tall crown-like head unit, with long hanging shoulder plates — a ceremonial, elegant shape; 7) separate armor pieces rather than one shell — plates on the shoulders, forearms, chest, waist, thighs and shins, with a dark fitted inner suit showing between them; 8) sparse outer plates over an exposed mechanical skeleton of metal struts, pistons and cables — light and precise; 9) ring-shaped armor bands floating free around her waist and ankles, with light body armor — the floating rings make the shape. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): floodlight white, light silvery aluminium, faint brass-yellow tarnish, cool Nordic night blue.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): pale silver-white hair bright as a stadium floodlight, with a faint pale-yellow tarnish at the tips. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Sc) and atomic number (21) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

Detailed design for this image:
Choose silhouette 7, separate armor pieces rather than one shell — plates on shoulders, forearms, chest, waist, thighs and shins, with a dark fitted inner suit visible between them. Adult pilot with a soft diamond face, emerald eyes, porcelain skin, silver-white long high ponytail fading pale-yellow at tips, side-swept bangs. Full silver-alloy armor from torso to both feet with white floodlight channels, Nordic-blue joints and pale brass-yellow rims. Only bare upper arms/shoulders and a deep chest window expose skin, intimate areas covered. Signature construction: rigid hollow triangular silver-alloy trusses form a pair of narrow racing outriggers behind the shoulders, light yet strong, lamp chambers integrated in their vertices. Both empty natural five-fingered human hands visible. Standing front-facing on an airborne pit deck, one leg advanced, glowing race gates above clouds at night, white stadium lamps illuminate face. Full-body eye-level composition.
